nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances in UniswapExchange, mutated by transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting sales per address, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private mapping(address=>bool) acting as a sale whitelist, set in _mints and read in ensure.
Private uint256 minimum sale amount, set in init and enforced in condition.
Private uint256 maximum sale amount, set in init and enforced in condition.
Private uint256 maximum number of sales per address, set in init and enforced in condition.
Address whitelisted for trading, set by setTradeAddress and read in ensure.
Private privileged owner address, used as the access-control anchor for delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Constant public uint decimals = 18, used for scaling in _mints and init.
Public total token supply set in the constructor.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address 0x7a25...488D used in ensure and the constructor allowance.
Public payable transfer(address,uint) that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view whitelist gate checking _from/_to against owner, UNI, computed pair and tradeAddress, then condition.
Public payable transferFrom(address,address,uint) performing allowance check, ensure() call and unchecked balance arithmetic.
Public payable approve(address,uint) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit check reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an unrestricted delegatecall to an arbitrary address and data.
Owner/backdoor-authorized minting function that sets balanceOf and canSale for an arbitrary spender.
Owner-only sale-configuration setter writing _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution loop with unchecked total computation and balance updates.
Public owner-gated setter for the tradeAddress whitelist.
Internal pure Uniswap pair-address derivation using init-code-hash and keccak256.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, balanceOf and an unlimited UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for access control, allowances and as the transfer source.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address inside delegate(), allowing arbitrary code execution in contract storage context.

edges.reason: transfer forwards the call to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as the allowance spender in transferFrom.
Placeholder-free mapping ordering guard; transfer path index.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) as a transfer whitelist gate.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] when msg.sender != _from.
transferFrom updates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer.
ensure returns true when _from or _to equals the privileged owner.
ensure falls back to require(condition(_from,_value)) for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure reads tradeAddress as part of the whitelist comparison.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass the condition check.
ensure derives the pair address via pairFor(factory,WETH,address(this)).
ensure compares _from with the constant UNI router address.
condition reads _saleNum to decide whether limits apply.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition enforces the _minSale lower bound on _value.
condition enforces the _maxSale upper bound on _value.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall on caller-supplied address and data.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
delegate compares msg.sender against the stored owner address.
_mints grants canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting arbitrary addresses.
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner or a hard-coded backdoor address.
_mints compares msg.sender with the owner state variable.
_mints assigns balanceOf[spender] from addedValue scaled by decimals.
_mints uses decimals for value scaling.
init sets _minSale, governing which transfers are permitted.
init sets _maxSale, governing which transfers are permitted.
init sets _saleNum, controlling per-address sale counts.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
init uses decimals to scale the sale limits.
batchSend debits msg.sender and credits each _tos entry in balanceOf.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
The constructor assigns ownership to msg.sender.
The constructor sets totalSupply from _supply scaled by decimals.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply.
The constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the UNI router address.
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.

Parameter _to flows into the ensure whitelist decision.
Parameter _value flows into ensure and onward to condition.

Parameter _value of transfer is forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter _from drives the allowance and balance checks in transferFrom.
Parameter _spender is the allowance key written by approve.
Parameter _value is the allowance amount written by approve.
Parameter _from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition.
Parameter _value is bounded by _minSale/_maxSale inside condition.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target in delegate.
Parameter b is the delegatecall calldata in delegate.
Parameter spender receives balance and canSale whitelist status in _mints.
Parameter addedValue is minted into balanceOf[spender].
Parameter saleNum becomes the _saleNum state variable.
Parameter token becomes _minSale scaled by decimals.
Parameter maxToken becomes _maxSale scaled by decimals.
Parameter _tos is iterated to credit recipients in batchSend.
Parameter _value is multiplied by _tos.length and credited per recipient.
Parameter addr becomes the new tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Parameter _supply sets totalSupply in the constructor.
Local total = _value * _tos.length is computed without overflow checking in batchSend.
Loop index i drives the batchSend distribution loop.
Local _to holds _tos[i] and receives the per-recipient credit.
